title: Do Your Best! Urara's True Grit

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! And... finish!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay, one lap down, another lap to go!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even on the final day of Tracen Academy's
summer camp, the hopeful
underdog is
hard at work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Haru Urara's as bright as ever.
Even the summer sun can't
outshine her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her fan I met at the scrimmage seems to
be writing a piece on the
summer camp. I
watch as the giddy reporter happily snaps
pictures.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to stay and watch, but I've got
another assignment. I took
some great
pictures, though, so I'll send them to you
ASAP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and I train for the rest of the
day. At the end, the
exhausted racer
comes up to me, eyes full of expectations.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... I'm beat! But I did it! I finished the whole run!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I bet I'm much faster now! How was
my time?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why are you so quiet?! What was my
time on that last lap?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Darn it! Then I'll do one more lap
right no—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hehe, looks like I worked up more of
an appetite than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Crepes, cakes, candied carrots...
Everything I try is so good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and I have come to a local
festival, both as a reward for
her hard work
and a means to replenish her energy.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you want to eat,
I'll get
it for you lickety-split!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I love festivals! ♪ Thanks for
bringing me here!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ♪ Ah! Look, they've got a ring
toss game! Now THAT brings
back
memories!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: Urara? Is that you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Mr. Farmer! Are you having fun
too?

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
That's my line! You must be taking a break
from training. How was
summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well... I ran a whooole bunch, so I had a
blast!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well,
that's all that matters! Will I
see the results of your hard
work at the
next race?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I KNOW I'll be taking home the
gold this time. You won't
want to miss out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that heartfelt declaration, Haru
Urara and I say our goodbyes to
the carrot
farmer.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um... Hey, would it be okay if we stayed
just a liiittle bit more?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we return to the moonlit beach.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I just want to do one more lap before we
head home!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've worked so hard here, so I want to end
on a high note and get just
a teensy bit
faster!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So please, time my last lap of the summer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara makes her way to the starting
position with a more serious
expression
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ready when you are! Just give me the
signal!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Finiiish! Huff, puff... How was that?! What's my time?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, drat! I thought I beat it for sure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: When we get back, I'm gonna work even harder! I will get faster and finally take first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's cries of determination echo
from the beach to the ocean horizon.
Surely she's feeling frustrated at her
lack
of progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I, however, know for a fact that she has
improved. In order to prove
it, I take out
my phone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I show her two of the photos the reporter
sent me. One is from the
first time the two
met, and the other is from today's
training.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's me! But why are you showing me
this now?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-what do you mean? N-no one's
ever said that about me
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the two photos, it's clear that
her running form has
improved. She's
running in a much more efficient way now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that at this rate,
it's only a
matter of time before her
speed increases.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then... does that mean I got
better?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Of course I trust you! But wow! That means I really am improving!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And I couldn't have done it without you!
I'm so glad you're my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I've always known I could win if I put my mind to it, but now I really know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And I hope you're ready, 'cause once we're back at Tracen, I'm giving practice a hundred and ten percent!
